comment: One layout for every system: the program in the system's program folder, the user's data where the system keeps app data, caches where the system may clear them. engine/cpp/app/paths implements it; amix_paths_json() / settings.folders report what a running build resolved.

program_files: AudioMixerASIO64.dll (the ASIO driver, registered in place by AmF X1.exe --install-driver)

android.note: MainActivity calls Engine.setDirs(filesDir, cacheDir, cacheDir); Android clears the cache when space is short, so only re-creatable files go there

macos.data: <program>/AmF X1 Data when writable, else ~/Library/Application Support/AmF X1

compatibility: an earlier build's ~/.amixos is used as the data folder while it exists and the new one does not
